name: ai-content-tool
description: AI Content Tool - Character-based content generation system

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.clean: npm run clean:api && npm run clean:web
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run dev
scripts.logs: npm run logs:api & npm run logs:web
scripts.logs:api: cd api && npm run dev 2>&1 | tee ../logs/api.log
scripts.logs:web: cd web && npm run dev 2>&1 | tee ../logs/web.log
scripts.health: curl -s http://localhost:3000/health && echo ' - API is healthy' || echo 'API is down'
scripts.status: ps aux | grep -E '(vite|tsx watch)' | grep -v grep || echo 'No servers running'
scripts.reset: npm run stop && npm run clean:db && npm run dev
